label: Regional tissue field

provenance.anchors_note: profile weights are [E] calibrations of the [S] ordering in FAT_REFERENCE R2 (Keninism distribution chart + android anthropometry). Terminal entries (foot 0.15, hand 0.12) added Nov 12, 2026 per MUSCLE_TISSUE_MODEL.md section 4: small but nonzero by design, measured by the v5.1 geometry from the Fat Males hand/feet deltas (GRAVITY_V5.md v5.1 addendum: wrist girth +2.98 cm total at full tissue, proximal fingers +13.5-15.4% radial thickness); Joe's correction (Nov 12, 2026): 'wrists and hands also need fat, not massive amounts but that is realistic'

semantics: Tissue is not one global number. tissue(region) = clamp01(level x profile_weight(region) x distribution_tissue_factor(macro(region))). The level is the character's explicit body.tissue.level if set, else a weighted mean of the tissue sliders present. The lifter profile follows the sourced male android ordering (FAT_REFERENCE R2: abdomen first, then thighs, upper arms, chest, flanks, back; forearms/calves carry little; hands/feet carry a small nonzero terminal share).
